title: Desktop-ready screens: an AI-built app as a full website
description: Imported by OWN-0 from runtime/executive/mission-imports/2026-10-23-customer-ownership.json. Source ticket: OWN-DESKTOP.
objective: Transform App -> Website gains a second option: the AI redesigns the layout of the app's own screens for desktop, without changing behaviour, data access or text, each screen as a reviewed draft with undo.
risks: A layout change must not alter what a screen does; the draft is limited to presentation and reviewed before it is applied.
Large screens may exceed what one model answer can rewrite; such screens are reported, not half-changed.

tasks.title: List the app's screens
acceptanceCriteria: Runtime lists each route and the file that renders it, for Next.js and React Router
The customer chooses which screens to make desktop-ready

tasks.title: Draft desktop layouts
acceptanceCriteria: Each chosen screen gets a draft using the app's own styling system and breakpoints
Behaviour, data access and text are unchanged; a draft that changes them is refused
Applied all or nothing, with undo

tasks.title: Desktop option in the Transform wizard
acceptanceCriteria: The wizard offers website pages, desktop-ready screens, or both
The owner approves it visually and the Transform UI contract is recertified
